title: AI activity header + tame model churn
note: branch lane/ai-activity-header (worker acdd2f1f). P1 HEADLINE (first increment — home screen currently unusable): unblock /dashboard/summary, which was timing out at 45s (Omar saw "too much AI usage"). Root cause: the summary synchronously fans out to ~8 LIVE connector/runtime probes on every load (Mattermost get_status alone is a live 15s round-trip). Fix: serve the last-known summary from cache instantly + background refresh + cached/bounded connector health probes. Then the rest of the lane: from user feedback the user can see LM Studio is very busy and doesn't know why — building a PERSISTENT header on all pages showing what service/workload is using which model (live) + a "Pause background AI" switch, now also showing email/Mattermost/VAMS sync status (folded in from the auto-sync lane below). Also auditing + fixing the churn itself — likely the dashboard insight engine re-narrating on every load/poll, and understanding backfill of newly-synced data hammering the local model needlessly. Carries forward two v0.1.25 perf follow-ups: LM Studio cold-load-per-request (add auto-keep-brain-warm) and app/database.py holding a SQLite session per-request (contention). Ships as v0.1.26 on top of v0.1.27's now-merged base. Only active build lane right now (organizer-efficiency retargeted to v0.1.28, see archive below) — its ETA has been asked for, since it also decides whether Omar should build-now or wait.
